title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本《孔融让梨》的标题页，画面中一位长者和两个孩子围坐，面前放着一盘梨，暗示即将发生关于谦让的故事。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
孔融小时候聪明好学，大家都夸他是神童。
孔融很懂礼貌，父母非常喜爱他。
page_text_en:
Kong Rong was smart and studious when he was young, and everyone praised him as a child prodigy.
Kong Rong was very polite, and his parents loved him very much.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了孔融小时候聪明好学、懂礼貌，深受大家喜爱的特点，画面中他正在窗边读书。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh: 孔融有五个哥哥，一个弟弟。
page_text_en: Kong Rong had five older brothers and one younger brother.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了孔融的家庭成员构成，说明他有五个哥哥和一个弟弟，画面中孔融正在下围棋，旁边有弟弟在玩耍。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh: 当孔融四岁的时候，有一天，父亲的一个朋友带了一些梨，送给孔融兄弟们吃。
page_text_en: When Kong Rong was four years old, one day, a friend of his father brought some pears and gave them to Kong Rong and his brothers to eat.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了孔融四岁时，父亲的一位朋友送来一些梨，分给孔融和他的兄弟们吃。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
父亲让孔融的弟弟先挑，
弟弟挑走了一个大梨。
page_text_en:
Father let Kong Rong's younger brother pick first,
and the younger brother picked a big pear.
summary_zh: 父亲让孔融的弟弟先挑选梨，弟弟选走了一个大梨。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
父亲让孔融挑，
孔融却挑了个最小的梨。
page_text_en:
Father let Kong Rong pick,
but Kong Rong picked the smallest pear.
summary_zh: 父亲让孔融挑选梨，孔融却主动选了最小的一个，表现出谦让的品格。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
父亲看后十分惊讶，问孔融：
“你为什么挑一个最小的梨啊？”
page_text_en:
The father was very surprised and asked Kong Rong:
"Why did you pick the smallest pear?"
summary_zh: 父亲看到孔融挑了最小的梨，感到惊讶并问他原因。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh: 孔融说：‘我年纪小，应该吃小梨，大梨该给哥哥们。’
page_text_en: Kong Rong said, 'I am young, so I should eat the small pear. The big pears should be given to my older brothers.'
summary_zh: 孔融解释自己选择最小梨的原因，表示年纪小应吃小梨，大梨应留给哥哥们，体现了他的谦让美德。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
父亲听后十分惊喜，又问：
“那弟弟也比你小啊？你为什么
挑个最小的梨？”
page_text_en:
The father was very surprised and asked: 
"But your younger brother is even younger than you! Why did you pick the smallest pear?"
summary_zh: 父亲对孔融挑选最小梨的行为感到惊讶，于是问他为什么在弟弟比自己更小的情况下，仍然选择最小的梨。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh: 孔融说：‘因为弟弟比我小，所以我也应该让着他。’父亲听了很高兴，夸奖孔融是一个懂事的好孩子。
page_text_en: Kong Rong said, 'Because my younger brother is smaller than me, I should also let him have it.' The father was very happy and praised Kong Rong as a thoughtful and well-behaved child.
summary_zh: 孔融解释自己选择最小梨的原因，表示应让弟弟先选，父亲听后非常高兴，夸奖他是个懂事的好孩子。

title_en: Kong Rong Gives Up the Pear
page_text_ocr_zh:
孔融让梨的故事使我懂得了一个道理：
我们要懂得相互谦让、做事多为他人
考虑，养成尊老爱幼的美德！
page_text_en:
The story of Kong Rong giving up the pear taught me a lesson: 
We should learn to be modest and considerate, always think of others, 
and cultivate the virtue of respecting the elderly and caring for the young!
summary_zh: 本页总结了孔融让梨的故事，强调了相互谦让、为他人着想以及尊老爱幼的美德。
